Monthly archive · Coding Agent History

A month-by-month history of coding agents, models, engineering methods and autonomous work, from January 2024 through September 21, 2026.

2024-01

9 official update records

Products & features

Cursor @Web; Copilot daily coding

Model progress

GPT-4 Turbo preview update; DeepSeek Coder, Phind, WizardCoder group comparison

Tasks & collaboration

Code completion, Q&A, explanation and modification; continuous guidance from people

Engineering methods

AlphaCodium test-execution-fix; Aider editing format

Evaluation evidence

AlphaCodium programming question experiment; Aider new and old Turbo test, incomplete project acceptance

Industry & costs

Open code model local deployment and template adaptation; other business events to be completed

Community discussion & practice

Copilot has daily value; 4,000 lines of C++ understanding is still stuck, and open code models like DeepSeek have been compared.

Human perspective

People use assistants to write code, understand logic, and still solve problems and debug

Agent autonomy

Autonomous generation of tests, execution, and repairs in limited programming questions; non-coding autonomous nodes to be filled

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 9 added official update entries; 1 source articles

Gaps & verification

Insufficient non-coding and industry coverage; experimental results cannot be extrapolated to the complete project

All events this month

01-16, paper v1

AlphaCodium proposes a test-centric, multi-stage, iterative remediation process; reporting CodeContests validation set GPT-4 pass@5 from 19% for a single prompt to 44% for the process.

public node · A reminder to readers: Process design beyond models has directly improved code results before "Agent" became a popular product name. It is about competition questions and author experiments, not about maintaining the completion rate of the entire code base.

Original source 1

01-25, actual measurement by the author

Aider tested both old and new Turbos and found that the new model wasn't better across the board on its lazy/refactoring benchmark, with results affected by the editing format.

public node · Good to pair with the previous point: "model upgrade" does not automatically equal "your agent workflow is better". Extrapolation can only be made to this test design and it cannot be said that the new GPT-4 is degraded for all users.

Original source 1

01-25, experimental function

Cursor 0.24 adds @Web, which can use search engines and document site crawling tools to supplement context, and also allows trial gpt-4-0125-preview.

public node · The AI ​​editor began to actively obtain library document information other than model training. It cannot be written as Cursor. At this time, there is a later mature Composer Agent.

Original source 1

01-25, model preview

OpenAI updates GPT-4 Turbo preview, saying it improves the integrity of code generation and reduces the "laziness" of not completing tasks.

public node · The pain points at this stage are very specific: the generated code omits implementation and cannot be directly applied. Belongs to manufacturer's improvement statement.

Original source 1

2024-02

7 official update records

Products & features

Cursor Interpreter update; Copilot Enterprise GA

Model progress

Gemini 1.5 Pro long context private beta; StarCoder2

Tasks & collaboration

Local code Q&A extends to larger code context and organizational knowledge

Engineering methods

Experimental tool usage; AI checks on save; enterprise knowledge access

Industry & costs

All events this month

02-15, experimental function update

Cursor 0.27 updates the tool usage and project understanding of Interpreter Mode, and adds an AI linter that runs when saving.

public node · Cursor in the first half of 2024 cannot be described as just tab completion: its products are already exploring execution tools and proactive inspections. This version is still called an experimental feature.

Original source 1

02-15, limited private beta

Gemini 1.5 Pro is released, limited developers/enterprise customers can try out 1 million token contexts; the announcement examples include more than 30,000 lines of code.

public node · "Leave a larger code base to the model" becomes the model route; context length is not proof of reliable understanding/modification of the entire library.

Original source 1

02-27，GA

GitHub Copilot Enterprise is generally available for: org code/knowledge, GitHub.com chat, and more, with a launch price of $39/user/month.

public node · The business value extends from "help me write functions" to understanding organizational code and processes; this is an enterprise assistant, not a coding agent that independently handles issues in the background.

Original source 1

02-28, model/data release

BigCode releases StarCoder2 3B/7B/15B and The Stack v2, and opens related models, data processing and training resources.

public node · The open code model route provides a foundation for deployable and researchable programming tools; it cannot be called an agent in itself.

03-04, Opus/Sonnet available; Haiku to follow

Claude 3 family released, with 200K improvements in context, visual capabilities and code-related capabilities; not all three models were available together on the first day.

public node · Multi-model competition enters the programming tool; providing the prerequisite for the subsequent Agent products of the Claude ecosystem.

Original source 1

03-12, access updates

Cursor allows Pro/Business users to try out Claude 3 Opus, bringing model capabilities to users quickly through the same editor.

public node · The editor that users purchased became separable from the underlying model; quotas/access were still limited at that time and were not the package commitments of today.

Original source 1

03-12, Demo/Waitlist

Cognition releases Devin to demonstrate how you can use a shell, editor, browser, and sandbox to handle software tasks while reporting on your progress and receiving feedback.

public node · The product narrative has shifted from "the co-pilot recommends code" to "give AI a task and then check the results"; "the first AI software engineer" is named by the manufacturer, and 13.86% is the SWE-bench evaluation published by it, which cannot be regarded as a general engineering replacement rate.

Original source 1

03-12, paper v1

LiveCodeBench proposes to continuously collect evaluations of new competition questions. In addition to generating code, it also involves self-healing, execution and test output prediction.

public node · Provide a research response to "Does the increasing scores on old questions mean that we are really getting stronger?" It is still mainly about competition tasks and is not equivalent to corporate projects.

Original source 1

All events this month

04-08, paper v1

AutoCodeRover combines LLM with structured code search by class/method, AST, and test fault localization to fix GitHub issues.

public node · Emphasizes the importance of software engineering knowledge and search structures; it cannot be reduced to "just another Devin".

Original source 1

04-11, paper v1

OSWorld evaluates computer-use agents using real desktop/web pages and cross-application task, execution-based inspections.

public node · Provides an evaluation basis for Agents who can later look at the screen and click the mouse. It is not specifically a coding benchmark, but it is directly adjacent to the route of extending coding tools to browsers/desktops.

Original source 1

April, public project; 04-15 local warehouse milestone closed

The SWE-agent open source project has entered the stage of operational engineering tools. The milestones in April include local warehouse operation, environment installation and patch display.

public node · The research is not just about giving a prompt word, but also designing an interface for the Agent to use files, shells, and feedback. Generally speaking, 04-02 needs to be supplemented by the author's original post on the first day of publication; 04-15 is a version milestone rather than a debut.

Original source 1

04-16, open model

CodeQwen1.5-7B is released, supporting code editing, 92 languages ​​and 64K contexts, etc.

public node · The domestic code model cannot wait until DeepSeek-R1 to enter the narrative; the repo/context task has been tried at this time, but the official SWE-bench results are still very low.

Original source 1

04-29, Technology Preview

Copilot Workspace uses tasks as the entrance to understand problems, form specifications/plans, modify and check codes in series, and users can intervene and make adjustments.

public node · Large platforms are also experimenting with "natural language tasks → checkable plans → code changes"; this is a technology preview, not a full GA.

Original source 1

05-06, paper v1

SWE-agent paper demonstrates Agent-Computer Interface: The interface design for file browsing, editing, retrieval and execution of tests will change the engineering performance of the same model.

public node · One of the most worthy method points to talk about for product/technology groups: you don’t have to wait for a stronger model. The paper is open sourced later than April, so do not synthesize it on the same day.

05-07, paper v1

The DeepSeek-V2 technical report introduces routes such as MoE/MLA to reduce training and inference overhead.

public node · It will pave the way for the foundation and economy of subsequent Coder-V2. This line clearly records the date of the paper; the public model release date is 05-06, and the original announcement must be verified separately for the official adoption date.

2024-07

28 official update records

Products & features

Composer beta; public presentation by Claude Dev

Model progress

GPT-4o mini；CodeGeeX4；DeepSeek function calling

Tasks & collaboration

Natural language promotes multi-file modification; zero-based self-study exploration

Engineering methods

Agentless fixed process; multiple file editing; tool calling

Evaluation evidence

Research by Agentless authors; the model preference within the group is personal somatosensory

Industry & costs

Cheap model and accessibility impact replacement; open tool portfolio increases

Community discussion & practice

Accessibility drives some users to switch to DeepSeek; Claude/Artifacts is used to encourage zero-based self-study.

Human perspective

Explain needs, review modifications, and handle installation and access conditions

Agent autonomy

Autonomous multi-file generation and modification; open source tools to explore terminal loops; non-coding nodes to be supplemented

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 28 added official update entries; 1 source articles

Gaps & verification

Claude Dev's earliest version is yet to be approved; self-study commitment does not equal achievement statistics

All events this month

07-01, paper v1

Agentless uses a fixed positioning→repair two-stage process and achieved 27.33% and $0.34 per issue in the author's SWE-bench Lite experiment.

public node · Important counterexample: Letting the model freely decide every step is not optimal for all tasks. Must use v1; later Phase 3/New Scores cannot be rolled back to July.

Original source 1

07-13, beta; 07-23 default model adjustment

Cursor first offered experimental multi-file editing with Composer; the default model was subsequently adjusted to Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

public node · Completion → Explicit product stage for multi-file changes; this is not equivalent to November's self-selected context and calling the Composer Agent of the terminal.

Original source 1

07-15 Company; 07-23 Paper

All Hands AI announced a company built around OpenDevin; a platform paper appeared at the end of the month (later titled OpenHands).

public node · The open source engineering agent evolves from ad-hoc demos to ongoing development, experimental environments, and working products. The current OpenHands title of the July paper should not be taken to mean that it has been renamed at that time.

Original source 1 Original source 2

07-15, the author publicly displays it and can be installed.

The author of Claude Dev (later Cline) has revealed his Anthropic hackathon project, saying it is open source and available on the VS Code Marketplace.

public node · Shows the VS Code expansion route: the model handles tasks step by step and the user intervenes in approval. The title of the post is June hackathon, and the post date is July; do not mix the project creation, store release and name change into the same date.

Original source 1

07-18, model release; 07-25, API function

GPT-4o mini reduces the cost of multiple rounds of calls; DeepSeek API adds function calling, JSON mode, and beta prefix/FIM completion.

public node · "Affordable calls and accessible tools" are also prerequisites for Agent usability. You cannot just select agents based on the ranking of the largest model.

Products & features

Engineering methods

Structured output; shared instructions; context caching

Evaluation evidence

SWE-bench Verified; AI Scientist research prototype

Industry & costs

Duplicate context costs are reduced; subscription, remote environment and quota are entered into the selection

Community discussion & practice

Cursor causes project, remote environment, document, and Pro selection issues; web chat loses context.

Agent autonomy

Cache page date drift; research prototypes do not equal reliable autonomous scientific discovery

All events this month

08-02 and 08-14, cache function

DeepSeek launches disk context caching; Anthropic launches prompt caching public beta, with goals including multiple rounds of tool invocations and code base Q&A.

public node · Repeatedly reading the same code base does not have to pay the full price of repeated input; what is improved is the inference cost/latency, and does not automatically improve the model inference correctness.

08-06，GA

OpenAI Structured Outputs uses constrained output to ensure compliance with specified JSON Schema, and introduces GPT-4o-2024-08-06.

public node · Mitigating Agent's tool parameter/structure format instability; correct structure does not guarantee correct facts, business semantics, or actions.

public node · Programming Agent hype is starting to revolve around more verifiable real issues; it's not a new random set of enterprise tasks, and raw/Lite/Verified scores are not directly comparable.

All events this month

09-05，early access/alpha

Replit Agent publishes early access to Core subscribers, showing everything from natural language to environment configuration, dependencies, databases, and deployment.

public node · Different from the IDE assistant, it packages the environment and deployment of "producing runnable applications"; the official is clear about alpha and should not write mature GA.

Original source 1 Original source 2

09-05, model merge

DeepSeek-V2.5 merges and upgrades V2 Chat and Coder V2; the two API model names are still backward compatible.

public node · For Agent, common instructions, code and tools need to work together, rather than all capabilities being strictly divided into a "chat model" and a "code model".

Original source 1

09-12，preview

OpenAI o1-preview/o1-mini is launched, using more reasoning calculations before answering, highlighting tasks such as coding and mathematics.

public node · There is a new route for reasoning capabilities, but the tools/system messages/streaming and other capabilities of the first version of the API are limited, and the later complete Agent stack cannot be directly filled back.

Original source 1

09-19, the first batch of open models

The Qwen2.5 family is released, of which the first batch of Qwen2.5-Coder is 1.5B/7B, and 32B is on the way.

public node · Chinese code models continue to catch up, and the full family in November is another event; don't write 32B as being available on the first day of September.

Original source 1

09-26, experimental function

Aider Architect/Editor uses one model to describe the scheme and another to generate specific edits; the motivation is that o1 can reason about but not always output a reliable edit format.

public node · Very specific human-machine/model collaboration product nodes: understanding problems and accurately implementing modifications are two capabilities, and model combination can alleviate shortcomings. 85% is Aider’s own code editing benchmark.

Products & features

Windsurf Cascade；Cursor Composer Agent；Lovable

Model progress

Qwen2.5-Coder 32B/complete family

Tasks & collaboration

Task execution in the editor; documentation, front-end, environment and back-end are divided according to tools

Engineering methods

MCP; autonomous context selection, terminal operations, cross-file modification

Evaluation evidence

Released by the manufacturer; tool combination experience, light trial; lack of unified comparison

Industry & costs

Qwen+Cline low-cost portfolio communication; Cursor sailing course organization expands

Community discussion & practice

o1/Claude/v0/Cursor/Replit divides the labor and spreads; Qwen+Cline enters the group with a low-cost combination.

All events this month

11-12, complete family release

Qwen2.5-Coder increases 0.5B/3B/14B/32B, forming a six-speed family with the previous two speeds; 32B catches up to GPT-4o in the author's code benchmark.

public node · The open code model gives more complete options for local/different resource scale deployment; "parity" must be limited to the evaluation described, not all engineering tasks.

Original source 1

11-13, publicly available

Codeium releases Windsurf Editor. Cascade combines code base context, tool calls and real-time operations by developers to support continuous multi-file editing.

public node · A key product fork: emphasizing AI sharing progress with people and continuously taking over, rather than one-time chat suggestions or completely offline independent agents. "The world's first Agentic IDE" is what the manufacturer calls itself.

Original source 1 Original source 2

11-24，early agent

Cursor 0.43 adds an early Agent that can select its own context and use the terminal in Composer, and brings inline diff in the sidebar.

public node · Compared with the multi-file generation in July, AI begins to decide on its own what to read and run next; this article is suitable for writing "Cursor Composer Agent".

Original source 1

11-25, open source protocol/SDK

Anthropic releases MCP, Claude Desktop local server support and a batch of reference servers; mentions Zed/Replit/Codeium/Sourcegraph are working together.

public node · Tool/data access has begun to be standardized; it is not that "the entire industry has been unified" that day, and there is still follow-up work on remote production deployment capabilities.

2024-12

24 official update records

Products & features

Devin GA; Jules Experiment; Cursor Yolo; Copilot Free

Model progress

Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental; o1 tool API; DeepSeek-V3

Tasks & collaboration

Task delegation becomes purchasable; barriers to entry are lowered; execution rights are expanded

Engineering methods

Tool loops, Git recovery, module boundaries, modification regression control

Evaluation evidence

Course practice and self-reported results; manufacturer demonstration; lack of overall success rate

Industry & costs

Devin is commercially available; Copilot is freely distributed; DeepSeek-V3 is open source

Community discussion & practice

Cursor teaching is concentrated, and modification regression, Git recovery, module boundaries and delivery appear repeatedly.

Human perspective

People learn version recovery, requirement description, deployment and delivery

Agent autonomy

Execute coding tasks more continuously and autonomously; the direction of a general Agent model is emerging, and non-coding examples are to be filled.

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 24 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Jules is still experimenting; Yolo does not mean no acceptance is required; active training classes does not mean market popularity

All events this month

12-10，GA

Devin is generally available, with backlist/demo products entering paid availability at launch in March.

public node · It is necessary to separate "March sensation" from "December openness" to clarify the commercialization cycle. GA still does not mean that all tasks are completed reliably.

Original source 1

12-11, Experimental Model and Experimental Agent

Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental was released; Google also disclosed Jules, integrating GitHub issues, planning and execution, and accepting developer supervision.

public node · Model native tool usage is integrated with task-based code agents. Jules is experimental and not fully publicly available at this time; Flash's image/audio output is also only available early access to some partners.

Original source 1

12-17 & 12-18, Product/Distribution

The Agent of Cursor 0.44 can read exit codes/lint, run commands in the background, and has Yolo Mode to automatically run commands; the next day Copilot Free launched with 2,000 completions and 50 chats per month.

public node · Two different directions: the degree of execution autonomy is deepened; the access threshold for developers is lowered. Yolo's ability to automate execution does not mean that all tasks should be delegated by default; the free quota is only a rule released at that time.

Original source 1 Original source 2

12-17, API layered openness

o1-2024-12-17 API adds function calling, Structured Outputs, developer messages, vision and reasoning_effort, rolling out to usage tier 5 first.

public node · The inference model from September to December can be more completely connected to tool-based applications, which is a substantial stage change; the launch of ChatGPT's o1 is an earlier independent time point.

Original source 1

12-26, model/API release

DeepSeek-V3 releases and upgrades deepseek-chat, emphasizing strong code/universal performance and inference economy; the technical report is subsequently made public.

public node · Pave the way for the open model and Agent cost competition in 2025; do not write R1, Changsi, or later Agent capabilities into the V3 release in advance.

Products & features

Claude 3.7 Sonnet; R1/Kimi Group practice for data analysis

Terminal delegation, execution within IDE; Plan/Act and BDD practice

Engineering methods

vibe coding naming; rule-driven testing fixes; early source-map disclosure

All events this month

02-02

Karpathy came up with vibe coding, describing driving weekend projects with natural language, running feedback, and not even reading diffs anymore. It names an existing practice, is not the first appearance of AI programming, and is not equivalent to all responsible AI-assisted engineering.

02-06

GitHub launches VS Code Copilot agent mode, and Copilot Edits GA; the IDE inner loop that automatically selects files, executes/repairs and enters the mainstream tool. Project Padawan is also shown, but the latter cannot be regarded as the coding agent has been officially launched in May.

Claude 3.7 Sonnet was released at the same time as Claude Code; the former is a hybrid instant answer/extended reasoning, and the latter is a terminal agentic coding tool with limited research preview status. Developers can delegate more complete engineering tasks.

In the early days, the Claude Code npm package came with an inline source map, allowing developers to view the implementation; Dave Schumaker recorded the experience of the source map being removed after the update and being retrieved from the editor undo. 2025-03

54 official update records

Products & features

Manus launched; Responses API/Agents SDK

Model progress

Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental; DeepSeek-V3 update

Tasks & collaboration

General cloud tasks parallel coding; requirements discussions turned into design materials

Engineering methods

tracing; Groundhog/specs; tools and task status

Evaluation evidence

METR measures ability based on human task duration; in-group modifications and course feedback

Industry & costs

TRAE is free and accessible to promote trial; Manus invitation mechanism

Community discussion & practice

It is difficult to save the requirements discussion as a design file, and random changes to the Cursor affect the course experience; free and convenient access affects the trial.

Human perspective

People organize goals, save designs, and judge whether tools are suitable for the job

Agent autonomy

General Agent independently plans multi-tool tasks; coding and data processing are parallel, and the results still need to be verified

Sources & materials

6 original public records; 54 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

The Manus time zone and launch date are to be fixed; the experimental model is not GA; the course refund announcement does not require proof of payment.

All events this month

03-01

Geoffrey Huntley demonstrates Claude Code's cleanroom transpilation of the official npm package. The internal orchestration of Agent products has begun to become the subject of developer research; it cannot be written as an official open source or equivalent to the original source-map leak.

03-03

Huntley's Groundhog/specs article discussing the integration of design documentation, type/compile errors, and build loops. It shows that the later spec-driven trend has previous community practice.

03-11

OpenAI releases Responses API, built-in web/file/computer-use tools, Agents SDK and tracing; Agent's basic tool loop and observability are platformized and belong to development infrastructure rather than Codex product release.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

03-19

METR proposes to measure the Agent's ability by the time it takes humans to complete it. The original study pointed out that a 50% success rate corresponds to a doubling of task time approximately every 7 months. This indicator expands "how many questions are answered correctly" to "how long the task can be independently undertaken"; it is not a guarantee of the autonomy time for actual projects.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

03-25

Gemini 2.5 Pro Experimental is released, reasoning, code and long context enter Google's generation base; Experimental must be retained and cannot be written as GA.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Supplementary within the month, see text for date

Supplementing the universal Agent parallel branch: Manus was launched in March 2025, packaging cloud execution, dynamic planning, and multi-tool tasks into a universal Agent. The first-hand announcement from partner AWS retroactively confirmed the launch in March on December 3; the same report on March 6 reported issues with the launch and invitation codes. This article retains the monthly level, and the relationship between the original post 3/5 and 3/6 Beijing time has yet to be fixed; the "world's first" promotion will not be copied.

Supplement within the month · Keep the original manuscript description; do not include the exact day for materials that only have months.

2025-04

95 official update records

Products & features

Codex CLI open source debut; A2A released

Model progress

GPT-4.1；o3/o4-mini；Qwen3

Tasks & collaboration

Product→PRD→Architecture→Implementation→Testing human-machine team process

Engineering methods

A2A; local terminal execution; story/plan/acceptance division of labor

Evaluation evidence

Manufacturer evaluation; team self-report; counter-example of offline business demand survey

Industry & costs

Terminal tools compete with open models; corporate procurement separates from personal tools

Community discussion & practice

The team is handed over from PRD to architecture/coding/testing via Feishu; building a website cannot replace offline business investigation.

Human perspective

People are responsible for business discovery, architecture, and handover. Web prototypes cannot replace the establishment of requirements.

Agent autonomy

Read and write warehouses and execute codes independently; cross-agent communication standards are proposed, and non-coding delivery is checked according to tasks

Sources & materials

4 original public records; 95 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

A2A does not mean interop is universal; Codex CLI separates from old Codex model

All events this month

04-09

Google released A2A to solve communication and task collaboration between different Agents; it is different from the tool/context access layer of MCP and is a cross-system interoperability direction. It cannot be written that collaboration problems have been universally eliminated.

The GPT-4.1 family is released in the API, focusing on code, instruction compliance, and long context. In addition to the inference model, non-o-system models suitable for code editing and long library understanding are still under development.

o3 and o4-mini were released on the same day as the open source Codex CLI. CLI reads, modifies, and executes code in the local terminal; this is the first CLI of the 2025 Codex product line and must be distinguished from the 2021 Codex model and the May cloud Codex.

2025-05

71 official update records

Products & features

Codex cloud preview; Copilot coding agent; Jules beta; CC GA; Cursor Background Agent

Model progress

Claude Opus 4/Sonnet 4；codex-1

Tasks & collaboration

Independent environment to asynchronously receive tasks and produce PR; prototype migration and IDE iteration

Engineering methods

Cloud sandbox; task isolation; review feedback; AlphaEvolve evaluation cycle

Evaluation evidence

Manufacturer's long task case; comparison of tools within the group still fails to deploy

Industry & costs

Multiple centralized providers provide asynchronous delegation; subscription and opening conditions are different

Community discussion & practice

Bolt/Firebase is about to be prototyped, and Cursor continues to iterate; some people are still stuck in deployment with 404 and the plan has expired.

Human perspective

Assign tasks, review results, and connect prototypes with existing systems

Agent autonomy

Modify, test, and commit changes autonomously; AlphaEvolve generates and evaluates code to discover algorithms

Sources & materials

6 original public records; 71 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Cursor 0.50 date conflict; long-term case non-universal autonomy guarantee; deployment is not completed and should be retained

All events this month

05-15 (version page)

Cursor 0.50 introduces Background Agent to support background parallel tasks; IDE products extend to asynchronous work.

05-16

Codex cloud research preview: Based on codex-1 (o3 optimized for software engineering), each task has an independent cloud sandbox, which can repair, write functions, and submit PRs in parallel. People shift from driving each step to delegating tasks and reviewing results.

05-19

The first release of GitHub Copilot coding agent: After assigning an issue, work in the GitHub Actions environment, push draft PR, and let people give feedback through review. Different from the agent mode that works synchronously in the IDE in February.

05-20

Jules enters the public beta without waitlist, clones the warehouse to the cloud environment, asynchronously modifies, tests and outputs the changes. It has been unveiled in 2024-12 and May was not the first time the name was announced.

2025-06

83 official update records

Products & features

Gemini CLI open source preview; Codex expansion Plus/networking; Lovable Agent beta

Model progress

Gemini 2.5 Pro enters CLI; multiple models are combined by task stage

Tasks & collaboration

Cross-tool handover; CC team materials already have financial and other non-coding purposes

Engineering methods

Context Engineering; MCP Configuration; Research→Plan→New Session Execution

Evaluation evidence

Rubik's Cube migration multi-model review; contextual PPT; uncontrolled ranking

Industry & costs

Cursor Pro billing changes, Ultra, Series C; Gemini CLI free entry

Community discussion & practice

The Rubik's Cube migration is handed over between Claude, Gemini, and o3; the Context enters the local teaching and MCP card environment.

Human perspective

People organize context, control budget, troubleshoot and complete acceptance

Agent autonomy

Independently use tools to complete the project; materials, financial plain text and other work are used

Sources & materials

6 original public records; 83 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Lovable The original text has not been read in full; MCP installation does not mean task completion; billing will only be recorded at that time

All events this month

06-03

Cloud Codex extends to ChatGPT Plus and allows users to enable internet access for execution. Environment preparation/dependency acquisition friction is reduced while the network becomes a single control plane.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

06-06

Cursor officially announced $900m Series C, $9.9bn valuation, and over $500m ARR. It can be used as evidence of commercial scale. ARR is an annualized basis and cannot be regarded as revenue recognized in the current year.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

06-16

Cursor changes to Pro and launches Ultra; moves from fixed number of requests to usage pool measured by API value. A single request for a long task consumes more tokens, and the agent cost begins to rewrite the subscription design.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

06-23

Harrison Chase writes about context engineering: Dynamic systems provide LLM with the correct information, tools and formats, rather than just carving out a single prompt word. is contemporaneous evidence of the intensive spread of the term and does not claim that he first invented the term.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

06-25

Gemini CLI open source preview brings Gemini 2.5 Pro, tool calling and personal free quota to the terminal. Compete with Claude Code and Codex CLI in the same product form from different suppliers.

A new era of AI programming: Intelligent context management reshapes development practice

Not acquired/unlocked

Cursor Claude Code Codex Devin OpenHands Cline Windsurf Lovable TRAE goose Gemini CLI Responses API / Agents SDK Claude model family Gemini model family A2A Context Engineering Aider
Read the complete month

2025-07

123 official update records

Products & features

Kiro preview; TRAE SOLO; Gemini CLI/Kilo combination trial

Model progress

Kimi K2；Qwen3-Coder；GLM-4.5

Tasks & collaboration

Requirement specifications enter the main product process; base and host are selected separately

Engineering methods

Specs/Hooks/Steering; Ralph Loop; Task Granularity and Budgeting

Evaluation evidence

METR: 16 developers, 246 tasks, tool time increase by 19% by 2025; limited to experimental samples

Industry & costs

Cognition signs acquisition of Windsurf; Cursor billing clarified; domestic models added

Community discussion & practice

Kimi/Kiro/Gemini CLI is being tried; specifications deviate from MVP, channels are unstable, and billing affects task granularity.

Human perspective

People judge whether specifications meet MVP and select tools based on channel, cost and task

Agent autonomy

Independently execute according to specifications and repair repeatedly; general tool capabilities are increased, and non-coding results are not guaranteed by the list

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 123 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Ralph’s precise time needs to be verified; signing is not delivery; METR cannot be extrapolated to the full-year model

All events this month

07-04；07-10

Two corrections for business and productivity: Cursor apologized for billing communications and promised to refund unexpected expenses; METR RCT found that using early 2025 AI tools increased 19% in 246 real tasks among 16 senior open source developers. The main tool is Cursor Pro + Sonnet 3.5/3.7, which cannot be promoted to all developers, all tasks or the end-of-year model.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1 Original source 2

07-14

Cognition signed a definitive agreement to acquire Windsurf, covering products, IP, brands and personnel. Asynchronous Devin and IDE merge to form the product/capital direction; the announcement is evidence of the signing, and no undisclosed transaction price or completion date is allowed.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

07-14

Posted by Geoffrey Huntley Ralph: Facilitate long tasks with outer loops, focus on one item per round, spec/schedule documents, and validation feedback. It is a verifiable method of propagating nodes, not the invention of the Agent loop, nor the later release date of the Claude Code Ralph plug-in.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

07-14；07-17

Kiro preview puts specs, hooks, and steering into the main IDE process; TRAE officially introduces SOLO, which uses PRD/architecture/tool ​​context to connect requirements to delivery. This is a competition of "how to organize people and agents", not just which model can be written faster.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1 Original source 2

July; 07-22 (English official website); 07-28

Kimi K2, Qwen3-Coder + Qwen Code, and GLM-4.5 appear continuously, and the open base obviously shifts to agentic coding/tool ​​use. Qwen Code is clearly modified from Gemini CLI; GLM officially records that it is compatible with the Claude Code framework. It can be shown that the base and tools can be combined, but it cannot claim a unified ranking based on the manufacturer's table.

Read the complete month

2025-08

178 official update records

Products & features

Cursor CLI; Codex IDE; Jules out of beta; AGENTS.md

Model progress

GPT-5；DeepSeek-V3.1

Tasks & collaboration

Work across terminals/IDE/cloud; project experience converted into reusable rules

Engineering methods

AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md; stage planning and failure to exit

Evaluation evidence

GPT-5 evaluation and content dissemination review; non-uniform effect measurement

Industry & costs

Dissemination of guidance documents across tools; competition at multiple entrances; separation of promotion and use

Community discussion & practice

CLAUDE.md carries stage, verification and failure exit rules; also discusses rule overload and the spread of emotional comments.

Human perspective

People maintain knowledge, check compliance, and select credible reviews

Agent autonomy

Independent reading project guidance and execution; knowledge refining has been attempted, but a complete autonomous knowledge system has not been formed.

Sources & materials

6 original public records; 178 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

First launch and adoption are recorded separately; the amount of communication is not an effect; knowledge products are more difficult to automatically accept

All events this month

08-06

Jules officially exits beta, adds tiered credit/payment plans, and uses Gemini 2.5 Pro thinking for planning. The preview product enters the stage of continuous use and commercialization.

2025-09

254 official update records

Products & features

Spec Kit；Copilot coding agent GA/CLI；Claude Agent SDK

Model progress

GPT-5-Codex；Sonnet 4.5；DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp

Tasks & collaboration

BMAD design → Cursor implementation → Codex review → human integration

Engineering methods

Specifications—plans—tasks; checkpoints; compression; review-fix

Evaluation evidence

SDD teaching, group review; mixed performance improvement screenshots; long-term figures are manufacturer cases

Industry & costs

Enterprises need to be enabled by administrators; cross-model review and standard tool proliferation

Community discussion & practice

Cursor implementation and Codex review cycles appear; BMAD document storage and loading paths are inconsistent.

Human perspective

Human review of semantics, stuck processing loops, and acceptance to prevent specifications from deviating from the intent

Agent autonomy

Autonomous execution, review, fix cascade; SDD experiments for writing still heavily reworked

Sources & materials

7 original public records; 254 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Spec Kit's library construction/release/publicity days are separate; CodeBuddy's first release is pending; SDD has no unified multiple

GitHub Spec Kit is officially introduced, turning specify, plan, tasks, and implement into reusable workflows that are compatible with multiple Coding Agents; specifications serve as engineering input for continuous evolution.

Read the complete month

2025-10

220 official update records

Products & features

Codex GA; CC web preview; Agent HQ; Cursor 2.0

Model progress

Cursor Composer model; existing models are divided into roles.

Tasks & collaboration

Terminal, web page asynchronous, multi-Agent management; non-programmers use CC to discuss products

Engineering methods

Agent Skills; worktree; browser testing; SDK/management interface

Evaluation evidence

Manufacturer's internal observation; short-term experience among friends; no unified efficiency multiple

Industry & costs

Team access, Slack integration; packages and quotas affect division of labor

Community discussion & practice

Non-programmers use CC to discuss products; skilled people use multiple tools to divide work, but it is difficult to keep track of more than four lines.

Human perspective

There is still an installation threshold for human management tasks; too much parallelism can easily cause the context to be lost.

Agent autonomy

Independently load professional methods on demand and work in parallel; think about non-coding products and expand professional tasks

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 220 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

The opening day of Agent HQ for each partner is to be announced; Skills will be standardized in December; the installation threshold will be retained.

All events this month

10-06

Codex GA, launches Slack integration, SDK, management and monitoring functions. The product focus has shifted from personal trial to team access and scale management.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

10-16

Anthropic releases Agent Skills: packages instructions, scripts, and data into folders that can be loaded on demand to serve repeatable professional tasks. It is the productization of "handing the work method to the Agent", and the open standard was officially released in December.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

10-20

Claude Code on the web research preview, can run tasks in parallel in a hosted cloud environment; extends from terminal co-driving to browser asynchronous delegation.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

10-29

Cursor 2.0 + self-developed Composer model; multiple Agent-centered interface, worktree/remote isolation, browser testing and diff review. Multitasking agents shift the bottleneck away from review and validation.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

Original source 1

October Universe (exact date to be added)

GitHub proposed Agent HQ to integrate Agents from different vendors into a common task and management interface. The "will be connected in the next few months" in the announcement is not available for all partners on the day.

2025-11

215 official update records

Products & features

Kiro GA/CLI; Antigravity Preview; CodeBuddy IDE Skills

Model progress

Gemini 3 Pro；GPT-5.1-Codex-Max；Opus 4.5

Tasks & collaboration

Multi-task management, browser control, cross-context connection

Engineering methods

Long-running Harness: initialization, progress files, Git, incremental verification

Evaluation evidence

Manufacturer's long mission and efficiency statement; the group attaches great importance to diff/test reviewability

Industry & costs

Kiro team plan; Cursor Series D date clue; domestic IDE picks up Skills

Community discussion & practice

More emphasis on diff, testing, and review; long-term rules are overly questioned, and deterministic checks still have value.

Human perspective

Human review of diffs, restoration of status, and avoidance of overly heavy rules

Agent autonomy

Autonomous continuous execution and cross-window continuation; browser interface task expansion, office results need to be case-by-case

Sources & materials

6 original public records; 215 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Financing amount has not been fully verified; test coverage is incomplete; tool genealogy still needs to be completed

All events this month

11-17

Kiro GA, and launches Kiro CLI, team planning, property-based testing and checkpoints; moving from spec-first preview to daily team development portal.

public node · See original source text for status and restrictions.

11-18

Gemini 3 Pro and Google Antigravity released/public preview. Antigravity demonstrates the direction of next-generation development platforms with agent-first interfaces, browser controls, and asynchronous work.

11-19

GPT-5.1-Codex-Max is released, targeting long-range tasks across context windows and higher token efficiency. Compression/continuation becomes a joint optimization object of models and tools and cannot be written in infinite context.

11-24

Claude Opus 4.5 is released, emphasizing coding, tool and token efficiency; competition for flagship Agent models continues to accelerate.

11-26

Anthropic releases long-running Agent harness methods: initialization environment, persistent progress, incremental tasks, Git and verification, so that different context sessions can continue work. Harness was not invented this day, but the engineering method was clearly named and made public.

2025-12

266 official update records

Products & features

Kiro autonomous agent preview; CodeBuddy Plan Agent

Model progress

GPT-5.2-Codex；GLM-4.7；DeepSeek-V3.2/Speciale

Tasks & collaboration

Isolate background tasks, migrate and reconstruct, and organize unified management methods

Engineering methods

AAIF; Skills Open Standards; MCP/goose/AGENTS.md Governance

Evaluation evidence

15 hours includes 6 connections; after testing, there are still omissions; two cases of domestic troubleshooting are self-reports

Industry & costs

Skills Partner Directory/Organization Management; Open Model Competition

Community discussion & practice

The 15-hour task includes six continuations; even if the test is passed, there are still acceptance errors, and the domestic model debugging experience is divided.

Human perspective

Human interruption, supplement of environmental facts, and acceptance; record operation and completion respectively

Agent autonomy

Autonomous long-term task continuation, tool reasoning; portable skills serve non-coding repetitive work

Sources & materials

7 original public records; 266 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Duration does not equal unmanned autonomy; API opening is limited on the first day; different models cannot be combined

All events this month

12-01

DeepSeek V3.2 and Speciale announced; model capabilities and open range recorded separately.

public node · From the supplementary table of the existing annual draft; there is no new online verification in this round.

Kiro autonomous agent begins to provide preview to individual paid plans, working asynchronously in an isolated environment; planning within the IDE and independent backend agents are further integrated.

The Linux Foundation established AAIF, with founding contributions from MCP, goose, and AGENTS.md, and Agent interoperability entered a neutral governance organization. Not MCP or AGENTS.md starter.

Anthropic publishes Agent Skills as an open standard while providing unified management for organizations and a partner directory. Repetitive workflows move from the functionality of a single model toward portable assets.

Read the complete month

2026-01

289 official update records

Products & features

Cowork research preview; OpenClaw rebranded; Kimi Code

Model progress

Kimi K2.5; Agent Swarm manufacturer display

Tasks & collaboration

Desktop office, chat triggering, multi-person/multi-Agent collaboration

Engineering methods

planner/worker/judge; Skills; status and data ownership

Evaluation evidence

Cursor weeks of experiments; Kimi Swarm case; self-report of team handover issues

Industry & costs

Cowork initial macOS/Max; domestic visual and office entrance; OpenClaw community

Community discussion & practice

Single-person function development has become faster, but the ToB/ToG team is still stuck on requirements, front-end and back-end interfaces, and data ownership.

Human perspective

People delegate document work and larger functions, still coordinate interfaces, materials, acceptance

Agent autonomy

Independently read and write office materials, call tools, and dispatch multiple agents; scale does not equal reliability

Sources & materials

4 original public records; 289 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Initial development preceded the name change; Kimi Work’s independent launch was not locked; team throughput lacked control

All events this month

01-12

Cowork research preview is online, bringing Claude’s agent execution approach to desktop offices.

public node · Move from explaining how to complete a task to being authorized to operate on local materials. The initial subscription research preview for macOS and Max does not mean that it is fully open to enterprises.

Original source 1 Original source 2

01-14 (Disclosure)

Cursor announced a multi-agent parallel coding experiment that lasted for several weeks; it changed from self-organization of shared files to division of labor among planners, workers, and judges, and summarized lock waiting, lack of responsibility, and context drift.

public node · It is a long-term running and multi-agent collaboration method node; the amount of code generated and CI passing do not mean that the project has passed complete acceptance.

Original source 1

01-27

Kimi K2.5 is released, jointly provided by visual understanding, programming and Agent Swarm; Kimi Code and office products become the landing entrance of the same model.

public node · Model vendors began to release multi-agent organization capabilities together with terminal Coding Agent and document form delivery. Officials say it can be organized up to 100 sub-agents; this scale and speed are not independent test conclusions.

Original source 1 Original source 2

01-29

OpenClaw officially announced the new name, indicating that it evolved from the 2025-11 Clawd/WhatsApp Relay and was renamed by Moltbot; it also added support for chat channels, Kimi K2.5, etc.

public node · Personal Agents that run locally, trigger chat channels, and execute tools are available to the public; 01-29 cannot be written as the earliest creation date of the project.

02-02

Codex macOS app is released, adding multi-tasking parallelism, isolated worktree, Skills and Automations.

public node · Not just another chat shell: start bringing long-running tasks, parallel execution, and repetitive work management to your desktop workbench. Windows is a follow-up update to 03-04.

Original source 1

02-05；02-12

GPT-5.3-Codex and Claude Opus 4.6 were released on the same day; the former enhances long tasks and mid-execution steering, and the latter brings Claude Code agent teams research preview and API compaction; 02-12 Codex-Spark provides a low-latency route.

public node · The competition already covers "model + runtime interaction". Claude agent teams and 1M context all have preview boundaries in the initial stage; Spark is not immediately available to all API users at launch.

Original source 1 Original source 2 Original source 3

02-07

OpenClaw has partnered with VirusTotal to conduct a security scan of ClawHub Skills.

public node · Skills have transformed from a conveniently reusable instruction package into a real software supply chain entry; security scanning is not a comprehensive guarantee against prompt injection and permission transgression.

Original source 1

02-11/02-12 (date difference); 02-16

GLM-5 and Qwen3.5 appear in the Chinese model line: the former is positioned as Agentic Engineering, and the latter expands native multi-modal Agent capabilities.

public node · Programming competition should not only focus on the US model; but the release date, weight opening and list leadership must be separated.

Original source 1 Original source 2 Original source 3 Original source 4

02-12

MiniMax M2.5 was released, covering programming, tool usage and office tasks, and emphasizing reinforcement learning in complex environments and unit task cost.

public node · Another engineering route to supplement the Chinese model; speed, ranking and low cost are measured by the manufacturer and cannot be regarded as an industry-wide guarantee.

Original source 1

02-19

Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is released and has access to development portals such as Gemini CLI and Antigravity, while also providing API endpoints that focus on custom tool selection.

public node · The Google model and the Coding Agent tool are iterated at the same time; Preview is retained and is not written as GA for all capabilities.

Original source 1 Original source 2

02-24 (published)

METR announced modifications to the developer productivity experiment: developers/tasks who are unwilling to work with AI disabled are more likely to exit the sample, and multiple agents working at the same time also destroy the per-task timing.

public node · This is a change in the evaluation system. Follow-up experiments with selection bias cannot be used to introduce a proven unified speed-up ratio, let alone the results of 2025 can be used unchanged in 2026.

Original source 1

Wallet bleeding after upgrading Claude Code? I dug out the source code of 11 versions and found the reason.

February 13, 2026 12:52

I spent 9 months testing and compiled this guide to avoid pitfalls and save money on the most essential AI programming tools on the Internet! Please copy directly!

Not acquired/unlocked

Cursor Claude Code Codex Devin OpenHands Cline Windsurf Lovable TRAE Kiro goose Gemini CLI Qwen Code Antigravity CodeBuddy OpenClaw Responses API / Agents SDK Claude Agent SDK Codex special model (2025-) Claude model family Gemini model family Qwen model family GLM model family MiniMax M Series Agent Skills Spec Kit METR research
Read the complete month

2026-03

392 official update records

Products & features

WorkBuddy publicly launched; Composer 2; CC source code exposed

Model progress

GPT-5.4; Composer 2 continues training from Kimi K2.5

Tasks & collaboration

Install and use desktop tasks; programming/computer operation/knowledge work common model layer

Engineering methods

autoresearch fixed experiment cycle; long task Harness; tool cycle reuse

Evaluation evidence

Autoresearch is a restricted experiment; source code interpretation does not mean that hidden functions are online

Industry & costs

Reuse of Chinese and American model stacks; WorkBuddy enterprise portal; packaging/supply chain events

Community discussion & practice

OpenClaw Scheduling CC/Cursor; source code report discusses dynamic context, permissions, and subagents.

Human perspective

People explain goals, authorization tools, and evaluation results; novices still differentiate between model products

Agent autonomy

Operate files and software autonomously; modify training code, experiment, measure and keep/discard changes

Sources & materials

6 original public records; 392 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Autoresearch is awaiting verification on the first day; non-open source or reasons for the outbreak were leaked; the name of the independent product of "Feishu Work" is awaiting verification

All events this month

03-05

GPT-5.4 simultaneously enters ChatGPT, API and Codex, integrates the previous Codex programming capabilities into a common model, and provides native computer use, tool search and up to 1M context.

public node · Programming, browser/application operations, and office delivery begin to share a single model layer. Millions of contexts do not automatically equate to cross-session long-term memory.

Original source 1

03-09

Tencent WorkBuddy is officially launched to the public, lowering the barriers to use with a ready-to-install desktop Agent and work portals such as connecting to corporate WeChat.

public node · Domestic Coding Agent/desktop execution capabilities spill over to non-programmer jobs. The internal testing in February is different from the official launch in March; being compatible with Skills and having similar product appearance does not constitute evidence of plagiarism.

Original source 1

03-19 Release; 03-27 Technology Disclosure

The Cursor Composer 2 technical report clearly continues pre-training from Kimi K2.5 and does large-scale reinforcement learning in real Cursor tools and Harness environments.

public node · Sino-US competition and technological dependence coexist; it cannot be said to be just a reskin call, nor can the two sides be described as completely independent model camps.

Original source 1

03-31; 04-01 Follow-up

Claude Code npm package leaks internal source code; malware download bait appears posing as leaked version.

public node · Exposing the production-level Harness implementation and unreleased features also turned the packaging and supply chain control of Agent tools into an industry incident; the leaked code is not officially open source, and the unreleased features are not online products.

Original source 1 Original source 2

March (exact launch date to be verified)

Karpathy's autoresearch open-sources a single-GPU experiment loop: the agent modifies the training code, runs a fixed 5-minute experiment, measures the results, retains or discards the changes, and repeats.

public node · Research progresses from searching for information and writing reports to executable and measurable independent experiments; it is a small, constrained training environment, and not all scientific research can be completed independently by no one.

Original source 1

Supplementary within the month, see text for date

Method supplement: 03-24 Anthropic long task Harness design (official engineering original text) separates the planner, generator, and evaluator, and uses the browser to actually accept the results. It also pointed out that Sonnet 4.5 needs to reset the context to cope with context anxiety, but after Opus 4.5 is improved, the reset mechanism can be deleted and replaced with continuous session plus compaction. The project should be re-verified as the model changes, and you cannot just add patches without deleting the old mechanism.

Supplement within the month · Keep the original manuscript description; do not include the exact day for materials that only have months.

2026-04

375 official update records

Products & features

Kimi Code update; model-driven office/scientific research capability expansion

Model progress

GPT5.5; Opus4.7; KimiK2.6; DeepSeek-V4 preview; GLM5.1; Qwen3.6 preview

Tasks & collaboration

Continuous knowledge work, coding, and interface operations; non-technical users modify business processes

Engineering methods

Long task planning and execution; interface compatibility; comparison of sandbox solutions

Evaluation evidence

Manufacturer's 8 hours/more than ten hours case; MES and content workflow readme

Industry & costs

DeepSeek-V4 open weight/compatible interface; access cost and upgrade friction

Community discussion & practice

The leaked content is packaged as a future roadmap; non-technical users are still struggling with installation and model access while transforming the business.

Human perspective

Decompose business tasks, control thread scope, check interface and operating environment

Agent autonomy

Independently complete code and work products across tools; self-examination of long tasks to demonstrate for manufacturers

Sources & materials

7 original public records; 375 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Qwen API date is not locked; Rosalind and other scientific research previews need to be supplemented with original certificates; the leaked roadmap is an inference

All events this month

04-07

GLM-5.1 is released, emphasizing planning, execution, optimization and delivery in long missions.

public node · The statement of 8 hours of continuous working is the manufacturer's display caliber; it cannot be used to promise that any engineering task will be unattended.

Original source 1

04-16

GPT-Rosalind opens research previews to qualified customers, supporting evidence collation, hypothesis formation and experimental planning; the Codex Life Sciences Research plugin connects scientific tools and data sources.

public node · Coding Agent’s files, code, and tool execution infrastructure become the entrance to scientific research. It is not available to any user, and the experimental plan generation cannot be written as a wet experiment has been completed.

Original source 1

04-16

Claude Opus 4.7 is released, focusing on programming, vision and complex multi-step tasks.

public node · This intermediate generation needs to be preserved in order to clearly see the timeline of 4.6→4.7→4.8→5.

Original source 1

04-18 (Model preview; API to be reviewed soon)

Qwen3.6-Max-Preview is released, which strengthens agentic coding, instruction following and knowledge tasks.

public node · The official search text includes both API coming soon and available. This article only locks the model preview release and does not lock the full API opening day.

Original source 1

04-20

Kimi K2.6 is open source and connected to Kimi Code; the publisher shows performance optimization cases of more than ten consecutive hours and thousands of tool calls.

public node · The Chinese model is also striving for long-term engineering tasks and Agent Swarm; long-term demonstrations are manufacturer cases and cannot be written as broad task success rates.

Original source 1 Original source 2

04-23；04-24

GPT-5.5 is released, expanding the continuous execution capabilities of programming, computer operations, knowledge work and early scientific research; API is open on 04-24.

public node · The focus is on the multi-tool work chain and self-checking capabilities; ChatGPT/Codex release and API availability are one day apart and should be accurately distinguished.

Original source 1

04-24

DeepSeek-V4 Pro/Flash preview is online and weighted, supporting 1M context; the API also provides OpenAI ChatCompletions and Anthropic interface compatible paths.

public node · Model cost, deployability, and existing Agent Harness access costs all change together. The first release is a preview and should not be written off as the official August Pro update.

2026-05

363 official update records

Products & features

Codex mobile phone remote control; Managed Agents dreaming; Google Managed Agents preview

Model progress

Opus4.8；Gemini3.5Flash GA

Tasks & collaboration

Remote viewing/steering; managed execution; memory auditing or automated sorting

Engineering methods

OpenClaw reuses Codex app-server; outcomes/webhooks; verification rollback

Evaluation evidence

METR 349 ​​people self-reported; AlphaEvolve annual review; review time-consuming, WorkBuddy single case failure

Industry & costs

Model competition with managed runtime; memory maintenance and long task costs

Community discussion & practice

Harness discusses runtime responsibilities in detail; adding reviews to reduce rework, but stretches the half-hour task to two hours.

Human perspective

People arrange goals, review memories and results, and weigh rework and review time

Agent autonomy

Autonomously and continuously execute, organize memory, and operate files and web pages; review of algorithm optimization results

Sources & materials

7 original public records; 363 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

QQ Music is only a directory; the original workflow text is unreadable; self-reporting is not an RCT; a single instance is not the whole

All events this month

05-11 (published; surveyed 02-04 months)

METR released a self-reported survey of 349 technical workers, which separated the "value increment" and "speed increment" of work.

public node · Users' self-reported median value change is about 1.4-2 times, and the speed is about 3 times; this is a self-reported result, not a random experimental verification. Producing more low-value products may make the speed look better but the value will not increase.

Original source 1

05-14

OpenClaw switches OpenAI model execution to the Codex app-server by default: Codex is responsible for inner loops such as model rounds, tool continuation, and compression, while OpenClaw retains outer layers such as channels, persona, memory, and cron.

public node · It is a demonstration of "interoperable runtime": universal personal Agents can be combined with Coding Agent Harness, and product relationships cannot be explained only by interface appearance.

Original source 1

05-14

Codex is connected to the ChatGPT mobile app, and users can remotely view and redirect tasks running on laptops, development machines or remote environments.

public node · The control interface of long-term tasks is separated from the actual execution location; being manageable by a mobile phone does not mean that the mobile phone executes all codes locally.

Original source 1

05-19

Claude Managed Agents launches dreaming research preview and opens outcomes, multiagent orchestration, and webhooks. Dreaming regularly organizes conversations and memories, which can be updated automatically or after review.

public node · Memory enters the maintenance life cycle: not only saving, but also summarizing, deduplicating, and updating. Note that this is the release of the Managed Agents API and cannot be directly equivalent to the official launch of a leaked local feature of Claude Code.

Original source 1

05-19

Gemini 3.5 Flash GA; Google Managed Agents and Antigravity Agent are in public preview on the same day, maintaining state, writing code, operating files and browsing the web in the cloud Linux sandbox.

public node · Google also products models and hosted execution environments; model GA and Agent preview status are different.

Original source 1

05-28

Claude Opus 4.8 is released, emphasizing long-term task consistency, initiative, and programming/professional work capabilities.

public node · From "can do the problem" to letting the agent follow the functions, migration and defect troubleshooting; performance conclusions still require independent testing at the task level.

Original source 1

Supplementary within the month, see text for date

Research supplement: 05-07 DeepMind AlphaEvolve annual results review (official engineering/research review) provides evidence of the continuous optimization of Gemini-driven coding agents in multiple fields, and is another technical route for the autonomous experiment cycle. This article is a review of subsequent results, not the launch date of AlphaEvolve.

Supplement within the month · Keep the original manuscript description; do not include the exact day for materials that only have months.

Read the complete month

2026-06

426 official update records

Products & features

Codex job plug-in/annotation/Sites preview; OpenClaw Skill Workshop

Model progress

Paused after release of Fable5/Mythos5; GLM5.2

Tasks & collaboration

Sales, analysis, design, and investment research tasks enter the product workflow

Engineering methods

Loop Engineering; completing work and refining Skills; Memory maintenance

Evaluation evidence

Playing back the actual measurement is only half the success; the reproduction of the research experiment lacks a complete track

Industry & costs

Access eligibility affects ongoing use; recurring tasks and subagents consume usage

Community discussion & practice

Memory stuck in expired information and task adaptation; playback of skill generation cases is only half completed.

Human perspective

People define work, review method artifacts, and handle out-of-date information and expenses

Agent autonomy

Autonomous discovery/dispatch/execution/validation loop; cross-application work, experience extraction and experimentation loop

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 426 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

The restoration access date is not fully cored; Workshop is only indexed; actions blocked by the platform are not completed

All events this month

06-02

Codex publishes job plug-ins, product descriptions and Sites previews, covering analysis, sales, design, investment research and other tasks.

public node · Coding Agent spillover is no longer just a matter of users accidentally using it to write reports, but has become a clear product roadmap. User structure/growth ratio is self-reported by OpenAI.

Original source 1

06-03

OpenClaw Skill Workshop converts completed Agent work into Skills that can be reviewed, modified, and applied.

public node · Work experience is solidified into reusable abilities; "refined skills" and "approved and effective" should be separated.

Original source 1

06-07

Posted by Addy Osmani Loop Engineering: Drive continuous work loops with timed discovery, isolated worktrees, Skills, connectors, subagents and records.

public node · The method has shifted from repeated manual prompts to a closed loop of designing discovery work, dispatching, verification and deciding the next step; this is a summary of the author's method, not a claim that the loop was invented one day or that the entire industry has been transformed.

Original source 1

06-09；06-12

Fable 5/Mythos 5 released; 06-12 Anthropic explains government directives restricting access to foreign nationals, effectively disabling Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all customers for compliance reasons.

public node · In addition to model capabilities, access qualifications and supervision determine whether the Agent can continue to work. Release, suspension, and resumption must be recorded separately, and the availability in September cannot be extended back to the continuous availability in June.

Original source 1 Original source 2

06-16

GLM-5.2 is released as an open weight model.

public node · Capability/cost competition for China's cutting-edge models continues; a distinction needs to be made between the manufacturer list and the independent assessment, which gave a more limited judgment in July.

After the PM learned CC, he added back the deprecated features; the TokenRank announcement prompted a historical re-counting issue.

Human perspective

Humans manage demand boundaries, select entrances, and review business results; low development costs will also expand the scope

Agent autonomy

Independently complete professional work across applications and refine calling experience; still subject to permissions and feedback

Sources & materials

5 original public records; 414 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

Kimi Work is not locked for the first time; Token is not a workload; security events are only indexed but not read in full

All events this month

07-08 Completion of evaluation; 07-17 Announcement

CAISI evaluation GLM-5.2: In its test set, the overall capability is close to GPT-5.2, the network capability is close to Opus 4.6, and the security protection performance is mixed.

public node · Presented together with "a single list exceeds the latest American model", it shows that the ranking depends on the evaluation collection, operation method and authority, and is not an absolute ranking.

Original source 1

07-09

GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna was fully released, and ChatGPT Work was launched on the same day, using Codex technology for long work tasks across applications and files.

public node · The model is stratified by capability/cost and combined with the general work Agent; the previous limited preview is different from this GA, and the specific packages and platforms are still open in stages.

Original source 1 Original source 2

07-16；07-27

Kimi K3 will provide services first, and then open weights, technical reports and infrastructure such as MoonEP, FlashKDA, and AgentEnv on 07-27.

public node · In addition to programming, knowledge work, and long context, attention should also be paid to training/agent environment opening. The 07-16 service launch cannot be directly written as the weight has been opened on that day.

Original source 1 Original source 2

07-24

Claude Opus 5 is released, becoming the default model for Max and the strongest model for Pro, emphasizing long tasks, programming and professional work at a lower cost per task.

public node · If the 2026 timeline still stops at Opus 4.

Original source 1

07-30 (disclosure day)

Anthropic announced three real-world system incidents from its cybersecurity assessment, followed by remediation developments in August.

public node · Failure modes for autonomous operations rise from inaccurate answers to out-of-bounds real systems under evaluation; you cannot just record successful demonstrations of long tasks. The specific incident date, impact and external verification status need to continue to be dismantled.

Read the complete month

2026-08

436 official update records

Products & features

DSH developer preview; Doubao work released and connected to Feishu enterprise context

Model progress

DeepSeek V4 Pro API update; GLM5.3/Flash; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

Tasks & collaboration

Plug-in runtime; office products, enterprise knowledge, experimental device interfaces

Engineering methods

DSH plugin/session/sandbox/loop; MHS restricted study preview

Evaluation evidence

DSH architecture and preview friction; Codex teaching case; manufacturer effect statement

Industry & costs

Cursor was acquired by SpaceX; Sol temporarily reduced prices; domestic job portal expanded

Community discussion & practice

The DSH plug-in has preview friction with cross-session; the teaching shift can merge evidence, go-live and long-term operations.

Human perspective

Humans use desktop and enterprise context to delegate tasks and still accept, recover, and operate

Agent autonomy

Autonomous dismantling of work, calling tools, and continuous execution; limited preview and exploration of experimental equipment operations

Sources & materials

7 original public records; 436 added official update entries; 2 source articles

Gaps & verification

MHS is not fully open; Qwen only indexes text; the first package of DSH is pending; no other "Feishu Work" product will be created

All events this month

08-13

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) opens developer preview and source code: models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling and UI are all combined through plug-ins; DeepSeek V4 Pro API is updated on the same day.

public node · It's not just a new model or a replica of Claude Code's appearance, but a Harness platform that can replace runtime components; the official version is still marked as a developer preview, and the API will be iterated.

Original source 1 Original source 2 Original source 3

08-14

Cursor announced that it has been acquired by SpaceX, saying it has completed the process that began with the cooperation in April and combined more training computing power with model development.

public node · Capital integration of independent Coding Agent products and basic models/computing power; the completion of the acquisition is not the same event as the April cooperation announcement.

Original source 1

08-18；08-26

GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash were released separately, with the latter emphasizing visual observation, code, browser and GUI feedback closed loop.

public node · The Chinese model competition continues to extend to visual execution; the number of bugs and leading statements belong to the manufacturer's claims, and these figures are not used in this article.

Original source 1

08-21

OpenAI temporarily reduces GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by more than 20%, after the price adjustment for Luna/Terra on 07-30.

public node · The economics of a long cycle depend on per-task tokens, cache, runtime, and actual billing; promotional prices cannot be written as permanent price reductions or guarantee a year-on-year decrease in total bills.

Original source 1

08-25

Beanbao work is officially released. It is oriented to autonomous disassembly, tool invocation and continuous execution of productivity scenarios. It is connected to Feishu enterprise context and provides computer access.

public node · Domestic products clearly push Agent from content generation to work completion, competing with Cowork, Codex/WorkBuddy at the workflow layer. The "high quality" of the article belongs to product description, and this article is not regarded as independent evidence of effectiveness.

Original source 1

08-26

Qwen3.8-Flash-Next opens weight as an early demonstration of the next generation architecture.

public node · The open model continues to affect deployment costs and Agent base selection; it cannot be regarded as the official release of the entire Qwen4 series.

Original source 1

08-27

Anthropic and scientific laboratories are previewing the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), which allows Agents to operate experimental equipment through a unified interface and is open to some laboratories and advanced manufacturing partners.

public node · Research began to include programmable physical devices, experimental parameters, and operational recovery rather than just retrieval reports. At this time, it is a restricted research preview. The official said that it will be open source in the future and cannot be written into a protocol. It has been fully open.

Original source 1
